_meta.author: TechLead
_meta.description: Handoff output templates per pathway. All outputs are admin tasks for human reception staff. The system does not make clinical decisions.

prescription.body_template: Patient {patient_name} requests {prescription_type} prescription for: {medications_list}. Preferred pharmacy: {pharmacy}. Run out: {run_out_status}. Please process and contact patient.
prescription.notes: Staff process prescription request via standard admin channel. Clinical decision on appropriateness rests with GP.

sick_note.body_template: Patient {patient_name} requests {request_type} sick note from {start_date}. Duration: {duration_requested}. Purpose: {purpose}. Please arrange with GP and contact patient.
sick_note.notes: GP decides on fitness assessment. Staff coordinate the admin process.

referral.body_template: Patient {patient_name} is {referral_type} referral to {hospital_name} ({specialty}). Submitted approx {approx_submission_date}. Please check e-RS / referral records and contact patient with update.
referral.notes: Staff check e-RS status. Clinical priority of referral is set by GP, not this system.

test_result.body_template: Patient {patient_name} querying {test_type} result from approx {approx_test_date}. Reference: {reference_number}. Please check records and arrange for appropriate staff member to contact patient.
test_result.notes: Staff locate result. Clinician decides on disclosure and interpretation — not this system.

appointment_redirect.body_template: Patient {patient_name} requests to {appointment_type} appointment. Urgency: {urgency}. Preferred clinician: {preferred_clinician}. Please contact patient to arrange.
appointment_redirect.notes: Reception books appointment via standard system. Triage staff assess clinical priority — not this system.

admin.body_template: Patient {patient_name} has an admin request: {admin_type}. Details: {detail}. Please action and contact patient if needed.
admin.notes: General admin request. No clinical involvement required.
